column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the device identity record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TestSessions(SessionRegistry), linking the device to its test session.
A VARCHAR(50) naming the manufacturer or brand of the device.
A VARCHAR(50) specifying the model name or number of the device.
A VARCHAR(50) denoting the firmware version running on the device.
A VARCHAR(35) indicating how the device connects (e.g., Wireless 2.4GHz, Wired, Bluetooth, Hybrid).
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring the device’s wireless range in meters (if applicable).
A VARCHAR(35) describing interference or constraints on the wireless connection (e.g., Low, High, Medium).
A BOOLEAN stating if the device automatically hops channels to avoid interference.
A NUMERIC(4,2) capturing variation in wireless latency (e.g., standard deviation).
An INTEGER specifying power consumption (in mW) when the device is idle.
An INTEGER indicating power consumption (in mW) under active usage.
An INTEGER showing additional power draw (in mW) attributed to any RGB lighting.
A SMALLINT for onboard memory size (in MB) for storing profiles/macros.
A SMALLINT specifying how many user profiles can be stored on the device.
A NUMERIC(4,2) measuring the microcontroller’s response time (in ms) to inputs.
A NUMERIC(4,2) describing microcontroller execution speed or frequency (possibly in MHz).
A NUMERIC(5,2) representing microcontroller timing accuracy (in percent or a relevant unit).
An INTEGER for the sensor’s primary DPI resolution.
A SMALLINT listing how many DPI step increments the device supports.
A VARCHAR(50) describing the sensor type (e.g., PMW3389, Optical, Laser, PAW3399).
An INTEGER indicating a secondary sensor resolution or specification (if distinct from DPI).
